svg.title: Bouclé Stack table lamp — 2D concept
svg.desc: A three-shell stacked table lamp for Bambu PLA Matte with fuzzy-skin boucle texture, a dark chocolate tripod base and a Bambu Lab LED Lamp Kit-001 module.
svg.text: Three oblique-cut shells · fuzzy-skin bouclé in Bambu PLA Matte · Bambu Lab LED Lamp Kit-001 · 235 mm tall, Ø149.9 mm widest
Axis lean alternates ±12° · rims are straight in true elevation, the openings are ellipses
Warm white 3 W · walls glow through 1.2–1.6 mm matte PLA
PLA Matte — Shells A / B / C and halo rings — the bouclé colour
PLA Basic — Hidden 1.2 mm diffuser — higher transmission
matte-dark-chocolate — Tripod leg frame + LED cradle — the walnut read
Outer wall of A / B / C
Wall low / high = axial height on the short and tall side. Draft = worst outward overhang when printed base-down.
Bases are inset 12 / 15.5 mm inside the rim below — absorbs the ellipse-vs-circle mismatch and sets the wide–narrow–wide rhythm.
no screw pilots until hardware is measured
6.8 mm wide · centred between front legs
Bond Shell A into the seat groove · cradle stays removable through its opening · USB stays outside
Hidden tapered tab clocks the upper shell; adhesive carries the cantilever
9 · EIGHT-PLATE PROJECT — P2S, one object each, no supports
